Rashi on Berakhot 61a:14:1.english: Male and female, He created them - This implies that from the beginning of their creation, they were two.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:16:1.english: That is why it is written: “And He built” - For it needed construction.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:16:2.english: What is [the meaning of] “And He built”? - For was it not already built?

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:18:1.hebrew: כדי לקבל את הפירות - שאם יהיה קצר מלמטה ורחב מלמעלה, תהא התבואה דוחפת את הכתלים מלמעלה לכאן ולכאן, שהמשא מכביד עליהם:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:18:1.english: In order to hold the produce - For if it were narrow below and wide above, the grain would push the walls from above to this side and that, because the load weighs heavily upon them.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:19:1.english: Best man - One who attends to his wedding canopy and his marriage.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:1:1.hebrew: הכל לטובה - אילו היה נר דלוק, היה הגייס רואה אותי; ואילו היה החמור נוער או התרנגול קורא, היה הגייס בא ושובה אותי:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:1:1.english: All is for the best - Had the candle been lit, the army would have seen me; and had the donkey brayed or the rooster crowed, the army would have come and taken me captive.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:1.hebrew: ולמ"ד פרצוף - ומתחלתו היה מצד אחד זכר, ונקבה מצד אחר:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:1.english: And according to the one who said [a] face - And from its beginning, it was male on one side and female on the other side.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:2.english: Which of them walked in front - Which face walked in front?

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:3.hebrew: אפי' היא אשתו - גנאי הדבר:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:3.english: Even if she is his wife - It is disgraceful.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:4.hebrew: נזדמנה לו על הגשר - אשת איש, והיא לפניו:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:4.english: If [a woman] happened upon him on the bridge - [This refers to] a married woman, and she is in front of him.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:5.english: He should move her to the side - Until he passes in front of her.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:6.hebrew: אחורי אשה בנהר - אחורי אשת איש, מגבהת בגדיה מפני המים, וזה מסתכל בה:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:20:6.english: Behind a woman in a river - Behind a married woman: she lifts her garments on account of the water, and this man gazes at her.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:21:1.hebrew: יד ליד לא ינקה רע - אפילו כמשה רבינו שקבל תורה מימינו של הקב"ה, לא ינקה רע. וקרא באשה משתעי:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:21:1.english: Hand to hand, the evil [man] shall not go unpunished - Even [if one is] like Moses our teacher, who received the Torah from the right hand of the Holy One, Blessed be He, he will not go unpunished [from] evil. And the verse is speaking of a woman.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:22:1.hebrew: עם הארץ - לא שמש תלמידי חכמים, שלא למד משנה זו ששנינו: לא יהלך אדם אחורי אשה, ואפילו היא אשתו:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:22:1.english: An ignoramus - He had not served Torah scholars, as he had not learned this teaching that we learned: A person should not walk behind a woman, even if she is his wife.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:24:1.hebrew: ולמאי דקאמר רב נחמן - שהלך אחריה ממש, אם כן, אפילו בי רב — עם תינוקות של בית רבן — נמי לא קרא:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:24:1.english: And according to what Rav Naḥman said - That he literally walked behind her; if so, he did not even read [Scripture] in school — with schoolchildren.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:25:1.hebrew: בשעה שהצבור מתפללים - דכיון שאינו נכנס, נראה כפורק עול ומבזה בית הכנסת:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:25:1.english: When the congregation is praying - For since he does not enter, he appears as one who casts off the yoke and treats the synagogue with contempt.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:26:1.hebrew: ואי דרי מידי - אין כאן גנאי, דמוכחא מילתא דהאי דלא נכנס מפני המשוי:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:26:1.english: And if he is carrying something - There is no disgrace here, for the matter is evident that [the reason] he did not enter is because of the load.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:26:2.hebrew: ואי איכא פתחא אחרינא - אין כאן בזוי, דמאן דחזי סבר: בפתחא אחרינא ליעול:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:26:2.english: And if there is another entrance - There is no disrespect here, as whoever sees [him] thinks: He will enter through the other entrance.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:27:1.hebrew: יביע - לשון אבעבועות. כל משקה מסריח מעלה רתיחה ואבעבועות:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:27:1.english: Makes [it] bubble - An expression of bubbles; any liquid that putrefies produces bubbling and bubbles.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:27:2.english: Transgression - He interprets it as an expression of wheat [ḥittah].

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:29:1.english: The kidneys advise - [They advise] the heart: "Do so."

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:29:2.hebrew: והלב מבין - מה יש לו לעשות, אם ישמע לעצת הכליות אם לאו. ומנין שהכליות יועצות? שנאמר (תהילים ט״ז:ז׳): ״אברך את ה' אשר יעצני, אף לילות יסרוני כליותי״. ומנין שהלב מבין? שנאמר (ישעיהו ו): ״ולבבו יבין״:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:29:2.english: And the heart understands - It understands what it has to do, whether it should listen to the counsel of the kidneys or not. And from where is it derived that the kidneys advise? As it is stated (Psalms 16:7): "I will bless the Lord Who has given me counsel; my kidneys also instruct me at night." And from where is it derived that the heart understands? As it is stated (Isaiah 6:10): "And his heart will understand."

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:29:3.english: The tongue shapes - [It shapes] the speech, to emit [it] from his mouth.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:29:4.english: And the mouth - These are the lips, [which] complete and bring it forth.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:4:1.english: Don’t we see that it causes damage - That it causes damage.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:4:2.hebrew: אוי לי מיוצרי - אם אלך אחרי יצרי, ואם לא אלך אחריו — אוי לי מיצרי, המיגעני בהרהורים:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:4:2.english: Woe unto me from my Creator - If I follow my inclination; and if I do not follow it — woe unto me from my inclination, which wearies me with [sinful] thoughts.

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:5:1.hebrew: דו פרצופין - שני פרצופין בראו תחלה — אחד מלפניו ואחד מאחריו — וצלחו לשנים, ועשה מן האחד חוה:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:5:1.english: Two faces - He created him initially [with] two faces — one in front of him and one behind him — and split him into two, and made Eve from one [of them].

Rashi on Berakhot 61a:5:2.hebrew: אחור וקדם צרתני - לשון צורה, דהיינו שני פרצופין:
Rashi on Berakhot 61a:5:2.english: Behind and before You formed me - [This is] an expression of form [tzurah], that is, two faces.

Tosafot on Berakhot 61a:20:1.hebrew: וכל העובר אחורי אשה בנהר אין לו חלק לעוה"ב - פי': אם רגיל בכך, לפי שיבא לידי נאוף, וסופו יורד לגיהנם:
Tosafot on Berakhot 61a:20:1.english: "And anyone who walks behind a woman in a river has no portion in the World-to-Come" - Explanation: [This applies] if he is accustomed to doing so, because he will come to [commit] adultery, and ultimately he descends into Gehenna.

Tosafot on Berakhot 61a:23:1.hebrew: אלא מעתה גבי אלקנה דכתיב וילך אלקנה אחרי אשתו וגו' - שבוש הוא, שאין פסוק זה בכל המקרא, ול"ג ליה:
Tosafot on Berakhot 61a:23:1.english: "If that is so, with regard to Elkana, as it is written: 'And Elkana walked after his wife,' etc." - This is an error, for this verse does not appear anywhere in Scripture, and we do not read it.
